notes.title: 0.7.9.0 Minor Update Release
notes.notes:
[h3]Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added features that remind/inform new players that tasks are key to progression
[*] Added a TV/status screen when you sit in chair to see who is ready and how loaded players are.
[*] Monster overall audio louder and more present
[*] AI spawning rates adjusted by a fair bit. Should be better overall experience wise
[*] Refreshed spook system. Removed bad spooks, fixed some, added new ones
[*] All batteries restore power at end of day, not just one
[*] Sub power station now displays % changes to battery life which is easier to understand
[*] Removed the tutorial. Was just not representative of our game.
[*] Overall HUD message visual improvement. Color and styling based on messages
[*] Upgrades sent notifications to everyone on notification HUD
[*] Made explosive mine more expensive. Allowing it to blow up gate in zone 2 now.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed revive not always working
[*] Minor interaction bugs and updated prompts on certain devices (the center help text)
[*] Fixed things 'floating' in bookshelves because they got stuck
[*] Fixed minor seed/hallway issue on zone 2
[*] Fixed weird issue of scanning a keycard (as last task) on zone 2 and getting forced into zone 3 (which doesn't load/work/exist)
[/list]

notes.title: 0.7.8.0 Minor Update Release
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Power system overhauled. Max power drain per battery added. Notification at 80% load added. Power will be reset upon exceed max power drain. Warnings added all throughout for players
[*] Added a unique sequence at power of < 1 minute to help notify players they need to get out.
[*] Added notification system on player UI to indicate "New Tasks" or "Power low", etc. 
[*] Lights overhauled to not drain power if no valid lights exist. Light switch will also darken to show it is not working
[*] Base blastdoor sealing changed to be more obvious and per door
[*] Fixed being given a prompt to interact with something through a static object (like a desk)
[*] Glow stick made more bright, even though that is not it's purpose. People seem to like to use it to illuminate things.
[*] Default battery time increased from 20 to 25 minutes for one load
[*] Minor tutorial changes
[*] Stat tracking updated
[/list]

notes.title: 0.7.7.0 Minor Update Release
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added a scripted sequence upon first load. It walks players through features and tools semi-organically.
[*] Game session will continue as long as dive attempts remain. No longer will all players dying result in a complete reset. Regardless of difficulty currently. This will be revisited at a later date.
[*] Adjusted the base 'end of day' button to be a lever instead
[/list]

notes.title: 0.7.6.3 Hotfix Release
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] AI less intense. Only applies to Mutant and EYES.
[*] Fixed some stat tracking
[/list]

notes.title: 0.7.6.2 Hotfix Release
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Sometimes weird physics object issues would exist on client alone. This is likely due to server releasing physics items before the client has loaded them. So now all clients and server wait for everyone else to load before doing a lot of 'initial' level state things. Hopefully fixing all client desync issues.
[*] Opening tablet in hiding place and when against wall fixed to be visible no matter what with little audio interference. 
[*] Fixed minor 'pick up' issue with monster fragments when under conference table.
[*] Fixed a minor collision issue with weapons and doors.
[*] Fixed not being able to run after depositing a monster fragment
[*] Fixed scoreboard/task board not being accurate for start of zone 2
[/list]

notes.title: 0.7.6.1 Hotfix Release
notes.notes: There were some pretty nauseating network/client experiences. Especially with doors and input lag. Those are largely fixed now. Tablet will no longer phase into the wall or lockers or desks when you hide. More importantly, the door doesn't beat you up when you're trying to pass through it on server or client
